turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Khan?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste maam, I am Rahul from the courier service. I have a large parcel here for you in Jaipur.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, a parcel? I was not expecting anything today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is a home appliance delivery, maam. The total bill is nine thousand five hundred rupees to be paid on delivery.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Nine thousand five hundred? That sounds like a lot, are you sure it is for me?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, the name and address match perfectly. I am just calling to check if you will be home this afternoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am here, but my son usually handles these things. Which area are you in?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am near the main market area right now. I can reach your house in about twenty minutes.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, but please call me again when you reach the gate because the bell is broken.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem at all, Mrs. Khan. I will call your mobile once I arrive.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright, thank you beta. I will keep the cash ready.
